# SCANNER CHANGES OVER TIME

## 0. Data and libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(BBmisc)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(cluster)
library(stringr)
library(factoextra)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
library(emmeans)
library(influence.ME)
library(rstatix)
library(ggseg)
library(ggseg3d)
library(reticulate)
```

```{r}
thickness <- read.csv("PATH/zscores.csv")
thickness <- thickness[,c("SubjectID","age","sex","group","lh_frontalpole_thickness")]
```

```{r}
euler <- read.csv("PATH/euler_numbers.txt", sep = " ")
colnames(euler) <- c("ID","Euler_LH","Euler_RH")
```

```{r}
MRI <- read_xlsx("PATH/DATA.xlsx")
MRI <- MRI[MRI$Session=="T1",c("ID","Scan-date")]
colnames(MRI) <- c("ID","Scan_date")
```

```{r}
thickness <- merge(thickness,euler,by.x = "SubjectID",by.y = "ID")
thickness <- merge(thickness,MRI,by.x = "SubjectID",by.y = "ID")
```

```{r}
thickness$Scan_date <- as.Date(thickness$Scan_date)
```

## 1. Plot Euler over time

```{r}
events <- as.Date(c("2015-05-12", "2017-08-16",
                     "2020-02-18", "2020-09-10", "2020-10-22", "2021-11-10",
                     "2022-02-04", "2025-04-04", "2025-08-19"))

eulerleft <- ggplot(thickness, aes(x = Scan_date, y = Euler_LH)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = events, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Scan date", y = "Left Euler number") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size =10,color = "black")
  )
eulerleft
```

```{r}
eulerright <- ggplot(thickness, aes(x = Scan_date, y = Euler_RH)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = events, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Scan date", y = "Right Euler number") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size =10,color = "black")
  )
eulerright
```

```{r}
ggsave(eulerleft, filename="PATH/eulerleft.png",dpi=1200, width = 10, height=7)
ggsave(eulerright, filename="PATH/eulerright.png",dpi=1200, width = 10, height=7)
```

## 2. Spearman correlation

```{r}
thickness$Scan_date_numeric <- as.numeric(thickness$Scan_date)
cor.test(thickness$Scan_date_numeric, thickness$Euler_LH, method = "spearman")
cor.test(thickness$Scan_date_numeric, thickness$Euler_RH, method = "spearman")
```
